naslov: Hawks' Flemings suspended for elbowing Pelicans' McGowens in head
tekst:
NEW YORK -- Atlanta Hawks guard Kingston Flemings was suspended for a game without pay by the NBA on Sunday night for intentionally elbowing New Orleans Pelicans guard Bryce McGowens in the head.
Flemings was assessed a technical foul and ejected with 3:04 remaining in the Hawks' 121-99 road loss Saturday night.
Flemings will sit out Monday night at Indiana.
